# Template — Agri-Tourism Partner Listing Agreement

> ⚠️ **Template only**, not legal advice. Adapt with professional advice where needed.

**Between:** AgriSphere platform ("the Platform") and `[partner name / business / community trust]` ("the Partner").

## 1. Purpose
Partner lists agri/rural tourism experiences on the Platform's agri-tourism board (`/tourism.html`)
to receive enquiries and bookings directly from guests.

## 2. Listings
- Partner provides truthful listings: title, location, price range, inclusions, season, group size,
  safety notes and contact. Platform displays them as provided and may edit formatting only.
- Listings expire after 6 months and may be renewed; Partner may remove any listing anytime.
- Platform may remove a listing immediately for: misleading claims, safety hazards not disclosed,
  repeated guest complaints, or any unlawful content. Partner may appeal within 14 days.

## 3. Bookings, payments & fees
- **All bookings and payments are between Partner and guest.** Platform never collects guest money
  and is not a party to the guest contract.
- Lead/referral fee (if applicable): `[e.g. none at launch — commercial tier fee structure TBD]`.
- Platform may introduce paid placement/featured tiers later; changes announced 30 days ahead
  and never affect basic listing functionality.

## 4. Partner duties
- Honour published prices and inclusions; respond to enquiries within 48 hours.
- Maintain safety: disclose access, weather and medical considerations; keep first aid; follow
  national tourism, food-safety and child-protection regulations applicable to the activity.
- Carry appropriate insurance where required; Platform is not an insurer of Partner activities.
- Handle guest complaints fairly; unresolved complaints may be noted on listings after review.

## 5. Platform duties & limits
- Platform provides listing, matching and lead channels; runs moderation & reporting;
  publishes honest guest feedback where available.
- **No liability** for guest–partner transactions, activities, or partner conduct; Platform will
  cooperate with authorities and remove dangerous listings. Guests participate at their own risk.

## 6. Marketing arrangements
- Co-promotion (optional): Partner agrees to Platform logo/link on materials in exchange for
  featured placement in Platform seasonal campaigns `[if applicable]`.
- Bundles (optional): Partner may join package itineraries assembled by Platform or its
  destination partners, each package governed by this agreement + a package schedule.

## 7. Term
- 12 months, renewable; either side may terminate with 30 days' notice; listing content removed
  within 7 days of termination.
